name: Siyang RaN de 30 Days
source:
A story, a wish. Everything seems to be nothing unusual, but realizing a wish always comes at a cost. The visual novel 『饲养染的30DAYS』will present you with a 'normal' ending. Find your 'puzzle' in the story.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4045190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一则故事，一个心愿。一切看似平平无奇，然而实现愿望总要付出代价。视觉小说《饲养染的30 DAYS》将为你呈现一个“普通”的结局——在故事中找到属于你的“拼图”吧。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4045190/]Steam[/url]（经编辑）]
